Source Code
___________

Compile cyboi using "make cyboi"
Test cybol applications, e.g. "../src/controller/cyboi counter/run.cybol"
Analyse code using tools "valgrind" and "cppcheck"

Adjust Version
______________

Replace:
- copyright year
- version

Tool:
- adjust manually
- was actually to be called automatically by script "adjustcopyright" within "make", but currently does NOT work
- the "KFileReplace" tool does not exist in KDE anymore
- use text editor "Kate" menu entry "-> Edit -> Search in Files" (Hotkey: <ctrl> + <alt> + <f>)

Search Data:
- Search: "In Folder"
- Option: case sensitive
- Folder: /home/project/cybop
- Filter: *.c,*.cybol,*.txt
- Exclude: api*,backup*,bin*,build*,communication*,doc*,ide*,include*,mailinglist*,release*,tmp*,tools*,www*

Hint: The following is NOT working, since subdirectories are not understood as pattern:
- Filter: "dist/release.txt,examples/*.cybol,src/*.c,src/*.txt,test/*.c,todo/*.txt,AUTHORS,ChangeLog,COPYING,INSTALL,NEWS,README"

--

TESTING:
- hints taken from URL:
https://stackoverflow.com/questions/11392478/how-to-replace-a-string-in-multiple-files-in-linux-command-line/20721292
- find only affects the immediate directory
- grep can find files recursively
- be careful doing this within Git repositories, since it changes files within .git and messes up the repository
- white space needs to be escaped, e.g.:
sed -i 's/The\ fox \jump/abc 321/g'

find somedirectory/ -type f -exec sed -i 's/search/replace/g' {} \;
grep -RIl 'search' somedirectory/ --include={*.php,*.html,*.js} | xargs sed -i 's/search/replace/g'

find options:
-type f - search for file, not directory

grep options:
-R - recursive search
-I - skip binary files, so that only text files are considered
-l - --print-with-matches, prints the name of each file that has a match, instead of printing matching lines, needed for the other commands to follow
the slash / as delimiter may be changed to @ or +

xargs:
- transform the STDIN to arguments

sed options:
-i - alter the file directly "in place", without backup, remove this option for a kind of "dry run" mode without effect
s - string type
search - regular expression or search string
replace - replacement string
g - global, make the substitution for each match instead of only the first match

Administrative Data
___________________

Adapt directories, files, version in file "build/cmake/packaging.cmake"
Build project using "make clean" and "make"
Update files in directory "todo/" and delete old ones
Update ChangeLog
Update AUTHORS reading ChangeLog entries
Update NEWS subsumpting ChangeLog entries
Commit SVN
Tag SVN
Create tarball using "cpack"
Create GPG binary signature for tarball file
Upload tarball file to Savannah

Website
_______

Create new file for release in www/cybop/plan/
Copy content from NEWS to www/cybop/plan/cybop-x.x.x.html
Update www/cybop/plan/index.html
Update www/cybop/news.html
Update www/cybop/index.html
Update www/cybop/footer.inc
Commit CVS (website gets updated automatically)

Announcement
____________

Announce release in mailing list
